arrhenius_fracture/fatigue_v1.py.reason: FatigueWaveform/FatigueCycleHazardController are the fundamental waveform/controller pair every cyclic-integration call site already treats period_s/K_phase/_phases() as authoritative. The dwell (minimum_load_hold_s, base_period_s, period_s redefinition, effective_cycle_frequency_Hz, cycle_schedule) is added here so it is a whole-loading-protocol property, not a crack-rebonding-specific one -- consumed by ordinary cleavage/emission cycle-mean statistics (persistent_site_coupled_hazard_v10229.py::_phase_statistics) exactly as by the rebonding wake state, with no separate implementation needed in either place.

arrhenius_fracture/persistent_site_cycli.reason: CoupledPersistentSiteCyclicTipEngine.cycle_step_waveform is the real production cycle_step_waveform override (confirmed via the real engine's MRO in PX0's source_provenance.json). Its dt_consumed->cycles_consumed conversion previously used the nominal waveform.frequency_Hz, which is no longer the correct seconds-per-cycle reciprocal once minimum_load_hold_s>0 (waveform.period_s now includes the dwell) -- fixed to use waveform.effective_cycle_frequency_Hz, which is defined to equal frequency_Hz exactly (not merely numerically) when the hold is zero, preserving bit-identity. Also archives base_period_s/minimum_load_hold_s/cycle_period_s/effective_cycle_frequency_Hz in the returned result dict, per the mission's explicit per-hold-enabled-record requirement.
